definitions.explanation: The year before this one; the previous year. Used to refer to events or states in the year that just passed.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to Japan last year.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}の{夏|なつ}はとても{暑|あつ}かったです。
{去年|きょねん}から{日本語|にほんご}を{習|なら}っています。
examples.english: I've been learning Japanese since last year.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}の{夏|なつ}に{友達|ともだち}と{海|うみ}に{行|い}って、とても{楽|たの}しかったです。
examples.english: I went to the beach with friends last summer, and it was really fun.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}は{大|たい}{変|へん}な{一|いち}{年|ねん}でした。{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しもしたし、{新|あたら}しい{仕事|しごと}も{始|はじ}めました。
examples.english: Last year was a tough year. I moved and also started a new job.

notes:
{去年|きょねん} means "last year" and is commonly used in everyday speech.

YEAR REFERENCE SERIES:
- {一昨年|おととし}: year before last
- {去年|きょねん}: last year
- {今年|ことし}: this year
- {来年|らいねん}: next year
- {再来年|さらいねん}: year after next

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {去年|きょねん}の{夏|なつ}: last summer
- {去年|きょねん}から: since last year
- {去年|きょねん}の{今頃|いまごろ}: around this time last year

FORMALITY:
- {去年|きょねん}: casual/neutral
- {昨年|さくねん}: formal, used in writing and formal speech

Both {去年|きょねん} and {昨年|さくねん} can function as adverbs without particles.
